g.text: A local desktop app for searching MBOX email archives, previewing messages and recovering
just the attachment or message you need.
The original archive is opened without being modified.
Search without importing your mail into another service.
Save one attachment or the original .eml; existing files are kept.
Choose an MBOX from a mail export.
Build a separate local search index.
Filter by sender, date, filename or phrase.
Save the attachment or original message.
